import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a mobile-optimized browser game set in Adana, Türkiye: a dating game where two couples meet at a cafe and rob it.

## Requirements
- Turkish-language game.
- Mobile-first/responsive with touch controls.
- Romance/dating choices combined with a cafe heist.
- User specifically asked for two couples meeting at a cafe and robbing it.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a dependency-free static site: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/art.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/game.js`.
- Original title: **AŞK & SOYGUN**, set at “Taşköprü Kahvesi” in Adana.
- 4 selectable characters forming 2 couples: Deniz & Ece, Kerem & Selin; pick any one, their partner becomes the date, the other pair is the rival/partner couple.
- 3 visual-novel date scenes with 3 choices each, affecting ❤️ Kimya, 🤝 Ortaklık, 👁️ Şüphe.
- 3 heist plans: Tatlı Krizi, Şalgam Servisi, Kasa Hücumu.
- Heist is a 5-round timing minigame: tap when the rotating needle is in the teal zone; misses raise suspicion; 100 suspicion = caught.
- Partner support tokens slow the needle and widen the zone.
- 6 endings with localStorage archive/best-score persistence.
- Custom SVG sunset/cafe scene + 4 SVG portraits, downloaded local Bricolage/DM Sans woff2 fonts.
- Added Adana/Turkish humor (şalgam, kebap, acı, Taşköprü, Seyhan).
- Fixed Turkish suffix usage `{you}’dan` → `{you}’den`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core game implemented end-to-end: title, cast selection, 3 date scenes, plan selection, heist intro, 5-round heist, result screen, endings archive.
- Responsive mobile layout with safe areas, sound toggle, WebAudio SFX, haptics, keyboard support, reduced-motion CSS.
- Fixed date-screen layout: scene now fixed at `46dvh`; dialogue panel fills remaining space; choices anchored bottom for thumb reach.
- Added faint active-speaker portrait watermark (`#dialogGhost`) in dialogue panel.
- Added cast-screen tip cards and plan-screen suspicion note.
- Added heist background scene (`#heistBg`) and dark overlay for atmosphere.
- Rebalanced: suspicion carries from date; base miss gain raised from 18 to 22; thresholds for love/legend/crew lowered from 55 to 50.
- Verified visually via Playwright screenshots: title, cast, cast-selected, date, choices, reply, plan, heist intro, heist gauge, caught result, endings archive.
- Caught ending successfully triggered and archived; result showed stats Kimya 55 / Ortaklık 50 / Şüphe 100 / İsabet 0/5.
- Current successful heist run reached round 4/5 with ₺33,000, şüphe 40, kombo ×1 after one automated hit.

### Active
- Testing successful heist path: validate hit feedback, partner support, final result/ending, replay loop.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish current heist run; take screenshots of the successful result screen and check points/stars/endings.
2. Verify partner-support button behavior and its visual/state changes.
3. Test 390×844 and a shorter 360×640/667 viewport for overflow, especially result screen and date choices.
4. Add result-screen archive progress dots/line to fill bottom whitespace if desired.
5. Check browser console for JS errors (favicon 404 already fixed via `assets/favicon.svg`).
6. Consider committing final files if requested by user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all screens/markup.
- `styles.css`: full mobile-first design, layout, animations.
- `js/game.js`: state machine, date flow, heist loop, result/endings, sound.
- `js/data.js`: characters, dialogue, plans, heist rounds, endings.
- `js/art.js`: SVG scene and character portraits.
- `assets/fonts/*.woff2`: local font files.
- `assets/favicon.svg`: favicon.
- `screenshots/*.png`: visual test captures (`title.png`, `cast-selected.png`, `plan.png`, `heist-hit.png`, `result.png`, `endings.png`, etc.).

## Important Context
- Static server runs in tmux session `game` on `http://localhost:3002` via `PORT=3002 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`.
- Playwright was fixed by symlinking `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243` → `chromium-1248`; use `playwright-cli resize 390 844`.
- `playwright-cli` click selectors must quote attribute values, e.g. `.choice[data-i='1']`, not unquoted.
- Automated hit test helper polls `#gaugeZone` opacity/dasharray/dashoffset and `#needle` transform, then clicks `#gauge`.
- Date scenes: scene 1 and 2 have 5 lines (5 dialog clicks to reach choices); scene 3 has 4 lines (4 clicks).
- Chosen balanced path for max stats: S1 choice 0, S2 choice 2, S3 choice 1 → Kimya 55, Ortaklık 50.
- A prior run completed with the “Aşk Galip” ending and a caught run, so endings archive currently shows 2/6 in local storage.
- Do not remove the faint `#dialogGhost`; it intentionally fills empty dialogue space.
